data.raw_text:
I just love it when people challenge #NuNew’s vocal abilities.  It makes me go researching.  
The summary below excludes any untraceable or unverified songs,  focusing only on confirmed covers from reliable sources across YouTube which I could remember,  I am certain there are many more. 
NuNew has covered a total of 69 unique songs from various countries since 2021, showcasing a diverse range including K-pop, Disney, Thai pop, and multilingual ballads. Here's a breakdown by country of origin:
Australia: 1 song
China: 5 songs
Japan: 2 songs
Netherlands: 1 song
Philippines: 1 song
Puerto Rico: 1 song
South Africa: 3 songs
South Korea: 12 songs
Taiwan: 4 songs
Thailand: 18 songs
UK: 3 songs
USA: 18 songs
#NuNew @CwrNew
